verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਇਤ ਤੇ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਤ ਜਾਇ ਠਹਰਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees it te ula(n)gh ut jai Thaharaaviee ||

en.bdb: Meeting with Guru, a Sikh receives the Lord's word to meditate upon and by his untiring and resolute efforts become one with Him. He frees himself from the worldly matters and lives in harmony in the realm of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੂੰਦ ਪੇਖੈ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਓੁਨਮਨੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charam dhirasaT moo(n)dh pekhai dhib dhirasaT kai jagamag jot ounamanee sudh paaviee ||

en.bdb: He shuts his eyes from mundane worldly attractions and lives in the spiritual wisdom that helps him feel His presence in everything.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਕੋਚਤ ਹੀ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੋਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪਰੈ ਅਨਹਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: surat sa(n)kochat hee bajar kapaaT khol naadh baadh parai anahat liv laaviee ||

en.bdb: Weaning his thoughts away from the worldly attractions, his doors of ignorance are opened; he is distracted from all sources of worldly pleasures and he gets engrossed in listening to celestial songs and music.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਵਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: bachan bisarajit an ras rahit hui nijhar apaar dhaar apiau peeaaviee ||11||

en.bdb: Renouncing the worldly matters and shedding all attachment with worldly pleasures, he drinks deep the elixir that flows continuously in his (Dasam Duar) the celestial door of the body. (11)
